notes.subject: אלופינו
notes.rationale: אַלּוּף — 'tame ones' read as oxen (KJV 'our oxen') or as 'our leaders/chiefs' (same root as אלוף chief).

notes.subject: יוצאת
notes.rationale: 'no going out' — read as no breaking out of flocks, no exile/captivity (BSB), or no going out to war.

notes.subject: bruk
notes.rationale: פֶּרֶץ is a breach in walls (breaking-in); 'bruk' keeps the literal picture.

translation: Ol bulmakau bilong yumi i karim ol hevi; i no gat bruk, na i no gat samting i go ausait, na i no gat krai long ol ples ol bilong yumi.

tokens.gloss: long ol ples ol bilong yumi
